name: simplebooking
description: SimpleBooking data analysis skills (reservations, revenue, content, demand) for hotel customers, built on the IBE and BackOffice MCP connectors.

interface.shortDescription: Reservations, revenue, content and demand analysis for SimpleBooking hotels
interface.longDescription: Four skills on your SimpleBooking data: reservation insights (pick-up, pace, channel mix, commissions, cancellations, markets), a demand-driven revenue diagnostic (area demand, availability, MinLOS, direct vs OTA parity), a content and translation audit, and demand capture (is the property converting the demand of its destination). Sign in with your SimpleBooking account to connect the IBE and BackOffice servers.
defaultPrompt: How is next month going compared to last year?
Where am I losing money in the next 60 days?
Audit the content and translations of my hotel.
